experience.summary: AI research assistant for energy access in Africa: evidence-based answers with citations from a curated library of sector reports. Team of 4; I own the backend, AI pipeline, and infrastructure.
highlights: Built the RAG pipeline behind the assistant — hybrid retrieval over pgvector plus reranking(RRF) and the evaluation harness used to measure it: a labelled question set scored for factual accuracy against source documents, showing a 35% improvement over the keyword-search baseline.
Designed the agent workflow that routes questions, calls retrieval and citation tools, and refuses when the knowledge library lacks evidence — keeping every answer traceable to a source document.
Built the document ingestion pipeline (parsing, chunking, embedding) that processes hundreds of PDFs concurrently; newly uploaded reports become searchable in minutes rather than hours.
Designed multi-tenant data isolation with per-organisation access control and usage metering, so several research organisations share one deployment without any visibility into each other's data.
Wrote the AWS infrastructure as CloudFormation and automated environment setup, cutting the time to stand up a new environment from days to under 15 minutes.

experience.summary: Left in May 2025 to complete my MSc full-time.
highlights: Owned architecture and delivery of three client-facing products end-to-end (Python backend, React frontend), including the calls on security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
Ran project planning across engineering, product, and design: scoping, trade-offs, and delivery dates that held.
Wrote the technical documentation new engineers onboard with, covering core system workflows.
Led 15+ technical interviews on system design and code quality, helping set the engineering hiring bar.
Added structured logging and monitoring (Sentry, New Relic) across the application, cutting typical time-to-diagnose for production issues by around 25%.
Built analytics dashboards clients used to track talent growth and mobility across their organisations.
Cut API response latency 15% by profiling hot paths by removing N+1 queries and caching.
Automated releases with CI/CD pipelines, taking frontend deployments from a manual process to one-click and roughly 20% faster.
